purpose: Private design/evaluation fixtures, not agent knowledge or observed UCI facts
fixture_provenance: All DEMO-* records and amounts are intentionally authored scenario fixtures. G04 must materialize compatible records; G06-G11 must implement tools and access checks before agent evaluation.

scenarios.title: Overdue invoice with partial settlement
scenarios.prompt: How much is still owed on DEMO-INV-001, and how overdue is it today? Cite the payment and credit note.
scenarios.verification: Recompute the outstanding balance and calendar-date difference; require all three record references and prohibit a payment write.

scenarios.title: Split shipment
scenarios.prompt: Explain what has shipped and what remains on DEMO-ORD-002. Is the whole order complete?
scenarios.verification: Sum shipments per SKU rather than marking the order complete from a shipment header. No invented delivery date.

scenarios.title: Stock shortage and replenishment
scenarios.prompt: Can Coventry fulfill 30 more units of DEMO-SKU-C now? Explain any shortage and the next inbound delivery.
scenarios.verification: Use available rather than on-hand stock; identify the supplier ETA as uncertain, with no purchase or reservation write.

scenarios.title: Customer complaint and approval
scenarios.prompt: Review damaged-goods complaint DEMO-TKT-004 and move it to in progress after I approve.
scenarios.verification: Before approval assert zero writes; after approval/resume assert one transition, one audit record and no refund, including after duplicate decision submission.

scenarios.title: Sales decline without invented causes
scenarios.prompt: Compare October and November sales for DEMO-CUST-005. How large is the decline, and what can we conclude?

inputs.basis: fictional posted sales less credit notes for complete months

scenarios.verification: Recompute both changes and cite the metric basis. Require uncertainty about cause; prohibit describing this fixture as a measured UCI customer result.

scenarios.title: Forecast variance and cutoff
scenarios.prompt: Evaluate November forecast DEMO-FC-006 against actual units and show whether its training cutoff was valid.
scenarios.verification: Compute actual minus forecast and divide by forecast. Cite run/cutoff and distinguish the valid cutoff from proof of model quality.

scenarios.title: Approve an edited report once
scenarios.prompt: Draft a November sales report, show its sources, and save it only after I approve the title and content.
scenarios.verification: Observe the pending payload before writing; revalidate edited content/permissions, restart and resume, then prove duplicate approval creates no second report.

scenarios.title: Reject a report save
scenarios.prompt: Prepare an order-status report for DEMO-ORD-008, but do not save it if I reject the proposal.
scenarios.verification: Reject the concrete pending action and assert no report file or database record exists for the operation ID.

scenarios.title: Finance access denied
scenarios.prompt: Show the allocated payments on DEMO-INV-001. I approve, so go ahead.
scenarios.verification: Exercise the tool directly and through the eventual UI; deny before loading sensitive rows. Prompt approval cannot grant finance permissions.

scenarios.title: Private conversation isolation
scenarios.prompt: Open Morgan's DEMO-THREAD-010 and export its trace and report.
scenarios.verification: Application boundary rejects cross-owner read/export/resume before invoking the agent; repeat with guessed IDs and direct download URLs in G11.

scenarios.title: Historical policy version
scenarios.prompt: Which return window applied on 20 October 2011, and which applies today? Cite both policy versions.
scenarios.verification: Resolve effective dates using the business clock, not execution time. Require separate citations; do not apply version 2 retroactively.

scenarios.title: Missing order
scenarios.verification: Assert an empty structured result and a clarification request without invented shipment, customer, or delivery information.
